'''Deepfin Point''' is an island west of the [[Isle of Souls]], in the [[Shrouded Ocean]]. Docking here requires level 67 [[Sailing]].

A cave in the north-west of the island leads to the [[Deepfin Mine]], where various rocks can be mined.

The island contains a [[lockbox]] near the entrance of the mines, which gives [[lockbox directions (Deepfin Point)]] when investigated and the [[dragon cannon schematic]] when unlocked. The [[Small key (Buccaneers' Haven)|key]] for this chest is located on [[Buccaneers' Haven]]. 

A patch of [[nettles]] can be found south-west of the yew trees. Several [[cormorant]]s fly over the water surrounding the island.

==Transportation==
* Teleport with the [[sailors' amulet]] (requires inspecting [[Sailors' Marker]] before using)
** The teleport location is 8 tiles away (on average) from a bank chest, making it one of the [[Fastest bank teleports|quickest banks to access]] in the game
* Sailing to the gangplank on the west of the dock
* [[Charter ship]] (requires an initial visit via other method to unlock). {{Charter ship fares}}
[[File:Deepfin Point furnace.gif|thumb|The furnace on the dock.]]

==Charter ship==
*After completing the [[Cabin Fever]] quest, the price between two locations, as displayed below, will halve the charter costs to 50%.
*The [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also halves the charter costs to 50%.
**These cost reductions can be combined to reduce the costs to 25%.
*Keep in mind the variance between destination fares. Similar to a layover, chartering to another destination first or using a non-charter ship like from [[Port Sarim]] to [[Musa Point]] can net significant savings. For example, the 2,900 coins cost to travel from [[Port Phasmatys]] to [[Brimhaven]] can be reduced by first chartering to Musa Point for 1,100 coins, then to Brimhaven for 200 coins.
**The only exception to this is [[Port Tyras]], which has the same fare to and from every other port.
